name: quick-share
title: Quick Share
description: Upload files to your Cloudflare R2 bucket and copy public share links.
author: jack_schofield

commands.name: upload-file
commands.title: Upload File
commands.description: Choose a file, upload it to R2, and copy its public link

commands.name: recent-uploads
commands.title: Recent Uploads
commands.description: Copy or open links uploaded from this extension

preferences.name: bucketName
preferences.title: Your R2 Bucket
preferences.description: Bucket name in your own Cloudflare account.

preferences.name: endpoint
preferences.title: Your R2 S3 Endpoint
preferences.description: Copy the S3 API endpoint from your own Cloudflare R2 dashboard.

preferences.name: accessKeyId
preferences.title: Your R2 Access Key ID
preferences.description: Use a token scoped to your own bucket.

preferences.name: secretAccessKey
preferences.title: Your R2 Secret Access Key
preferences.description: Secret for your own bucket-scoped R2 token.

preferences.name: publicUrl
preferences.title: Your Public Bucket URL
preferences.description: Public URL or custom domain belonging to your bucket.

preferences.name: rclonePath
preferences.title: rclone Executable
preferences.description: Leave blank to find rclone in Homebrew or PATH.
